summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on April 20, 2026, disclosing that Ninety One (Pty) Ltd. acquired an aggregate beneficial interest of 5.2017% in Harmony's ordinary shares. The filing is a routine regulatory notification under South African company law (Section 122(3)(b) of the Companies Act) and JSE listings requirements, not a special situation. No tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic change is announced. The disclosure respects the transaction as a passive stake crossing a threshold, with no board recommendation, advisor, or conditions mentioned. Nothing further to watch—this is a passive filing.
